description: The Event Horizon – Timeline Chart is a powerful and highly customizable Power BI custom visual designed to help businesses track key milestones over time. Whether managing project deadlines, product launches, or critical business events, this visual provides an intuitive way to display and analyze milestones with flexibility and precision. With dynamic scaling options and customizable milestone attributes, users can tailor their timeline to fit their exact needs. From monthly, quarterly, or yearly views to adjusting the number of visible scale points, this visual ensures that users can easily navigate through their milestones without losing sight of key events. Key Features Flexible Time Scaling – Switch between Monthly, Quarterly, and Yearly views. Custom Date Range – Set your Start Date and End Date for a focused milestone view. Status Customization – Define unique colors and shapes for milestones in different statuses (Not Started, In Progress, Completed, and Overdue). Scalability & Navigation – Adjust the number of visible scale points to enhance readability and enable smooth scrolling. Multi-Milestone Handling – Display multiple milestones at the same point, ensuring clear differentiation.
